title: Naner Vendor Definition Schema
description: Schema for a single vendor definition file under config/vendors/. One file per vendor, holding exactly one top-level key; the file name must match that key.

description.description: Brief description of what this vendor provides

extractDir.description: Directory name within vendor/ where this will be extracted

enabled.description: Whether this vendor should be installed by default

required.description: Whether this vendor is required for Naner to function

dependencies.description: List of vendor IDs that must be installed before this one

postInstallFunction.description: Name of the PostInstall function to execute after extraction

installType.description: Type of installation (archive extraction or installer execution)

installerArgs.description: Arguments to pass to installer (if installType is 'installer')

checksum.description: Pin this artifact to a known digest. Takes precedence over any digest a resolver discovers upstream.

value.description: Expected hex digest (spaces, dashes and colons are ignored)

required.description: When true a mismatch blocks installation; otherwise it only warns

checksumSource.description: Where to fetch a digest for a dynamically-resolved artifact. Not needed for golang-api/nodejs-api/dotnet-api, which publish digests in their resolution response. A mismatch against a digest fetched this way always blocks installation.

suffix.description: sidecar only: appended to the download URL, e.g. '.sha256'

url.description: scrape only: listing page carrying the digest

pattern.description: scrape only: POSIX-ERE matched case-insensitively; capture group 1 is the digest and '{FILE}' is replaced with the resolved file name

packages.description: List of packages to install (vendor-specific, e.g., MSYS2 packages)

pathPriority.description: Where this vendor's pathPrecedence entries sit relative to other vendors'. Lower runs earlier and so wins conflicts; vendors without one sort after those with one, by key.

pathPrecedence.description: PATH entries this vendor contributes, in its own order. Substituted for the %VENDOR_PATHS% marker in naner.json's Environment.PathPrecedence.

environmentVariables.description: Environment variables this vendor needs. A variable set in naner.json wins over these.

assetPattern.description: Pattern to match release assets for type: github

url.description: URL to fetch release information or download file

pattern.description: Regex pattern to extract version/URL from web page for type: web-scrape

version.description: Static version string for type: static
Fallback version to use if API/scraping fails
